setupAdmin.title: Set up this phone
setupAdmin.subtitle: You are the first person to use Ausculta on this phone, so this first account is yours.
setupAdmin.whatIsAdmin: It is also the account in charge of this phone. When a health worker or a doctor asks to use Ausculta here, you are the one who approves them, and they cannot sign in until you do. People signing up as patients do not need your approval.
setupAdmin.usernameNotice: Your sign-in name for this account is “admin”. The password is the one you choose below.
setupAdmin.warning: Choose a password you will remember. Everything stays on this phone, so if the password is lost nobody can recover it for you.
setupAdmin.nextStep: When you finish, you will be signed in straight away — you do not need to sign in again.
setupAdmin.successBody: Your account is ready. Sign in as “admin” to continue.
setupAdmin.alreadyDoneBody: This phone already has an account in charge. Sign in instead.
